description: Computes, on the dividends the user gives (a year of dividends, gross, by payer: a ticker such as "NESN.SW" or a country code), the tax each payer's country keeps at source, the treaty rate, and what was withheld above it over 12 months, which only that country refunds on a claim; for a French resident, also the treaty part France credits on form 2047. Same engine as Portfolio Terminal's Income and Pro tabs: statutory rates as of 2026, a US dividend at 15% (W-8BEN on file), European-listed funds paying no withholding. Countries outside its table are named, never guessed. Nothing is stored. Use it for "how much Swiss tax do I lose on Nestlé dividends", "which of my dividends are over-withheld".

currency.description: Currency of every amount (default EUR for FR, USD otherwise).

dividends.description: One line per payer: a year of dividends, gross (before any tax). At most 100.

country.description: The payer's country, ISO code ("CH", "DE", "US"), when there is no ticker or it says better.

kind.description: stock (default) or fund: a fund listed in Europe pays its holders no withholding.

ticker.description: The payer's ticker with its exchange suffix: "NESN.SW", "ALV.DE", "MSFT".

residence.description: Where the user pays tax: FR (France), US, or other (the usual 15% treaty rate is used).

name: withholding_check
title: Dividend tax withheld abroad
